steps.instruction: Complete character creation with the Vagabond starting class, verify the Longsword, Halberd, Heater Shield, and full Vagabond Knight set, select the intended keepsake, and begin at the Chapel of Anticipation.
steps.warning: The Stonesword Key budget does not assume a Stonesword Key keepsake.

steps.instruction: Loot the Tarnished's Wizened Finger from the corpse inside the chapel.
Attempt the opening Grafted Scion encounter and record whether it was defeated or deferred.
steps.warning: Defeating the opening Grafted Scion grants both unique rewards now; failure is expected and the rewards remain recoverable during the Four Belfries revisit.

steps.instruction: Complete the forced transition from the Chapel of Anticipation to the Stranded Graveyard.
Confirm the Flask of Crimson Tears, Flask of Cerulean Tears, and Memory of Grace were automatically added after the Chapel fall.
Activate the Stranded Graveyard Site of Grace before entering the tutorial cave.
Descend into the Cave of Knowledge and complete every tutorial instruction.
Defeat the Soldier of Godrick at the end of the Cave of Knowledge.
Loot the Strength! gesture from the hanging corpse beyond the Soldier of Godrick.
Before riding the lift to Limgrave, collect the Finger Severer and Tarnished's Furled Finger from the passage beside the lift.
Inspect the Fringefolk Hero's Grave imp seal, leave it closed, and record the complete dungeon for the late-Act-I exit audit.
steps.warning: Do not spend two Stonesword Keys here during the opening. The dungeon is deliberately routed after Stormveil.

steps.instruction: Return to the Stranded Graveyard, ride the lift, and emerge into Limgrave.
Verify both opening sub-objectives, all starting equipment and system items, the tutorial boss and gesture, the Grafted Scion outcome, and the Fringefolk deferral before closing Objective 1.
Activate The First Step Site of Grace.
Activate the summoning pool beside The First Step and collect the Small Golden Effigy.
Speak with White Mask Varré and exhaust all available dialogue.
steps.warning: Do not attack Varré.

steps.instruction: Verify The First Step grace, summoning pool, Small Golden Effigy, and all initial Varré dialogue before continuing to the Church of Elleh.
Travel to the Church of Elleh and activate its Site of Grace.
Meet Merchant Kalé and exhaust his initial dialogue.
Register Kalé's infinite Throwing Dagger, Arrow, and Bolt stock; no bulk purchase is required.
Purchase the Crafting Kit.
Purchase the Torch.
steps.warning: Required for the definitive inventory and immediately useful in early caves.

steps.instruction: Purchase the Telescope.
steps.warning: Required one-stock merchant item for the definitive collection.

steps.instruction: Buy Furlcalling Finger Remedy ×5, Cracked Pot ×3, Nomadic Warrior's Cookbooks [1] and [2], and Missionary's Cookbook [1].
Buy the Large Leather Shield, Chain Coif, Chain Armor, Gauntlets, and Chain Leggings.
Buy Note: Flask of Wondrous Physick and Note: Waypoint Ruins.
Verify Kalé's full eighteen-line inventory is registered, every finite or one-stock item is purchased, and the 14,400-rune hub closeout is complete.
steps.warning: Use stored Golden Runes if needed; do not level beyond the active build tier merely to empty the shop.

steps.instruction: Follow the main road north and activate the Gatefront Site of Grace.
Rest at Gatefront, accept Melina's accord, unlock leveling, and receive the Spectral Steed Whistle.
Summon Torrent once and confirm mounted controls.
Fast travel to the Church of Elleh at night, speak with Renna, and receive the Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes.
steps.warning: Return immediately after receiving Torrent. If Renna fails to appear, pass time to night or reload the area; her items remain recoverable from the Twin Maiden Husks.

steps.instruction: Verify Melina's accord, leveling, Torrent controls, Renna's complete dialogue, Spirit Calling Bell, and Lone Wolf Ashes.
Return to Gatefront and approach the ruins from the southern side to begin a controlled sweep.
Collect Map: Limgrave, West from the map stele on the main road.
Clear or safely neutralize the Gatefront camp, including the Godrick Knight, and register all farmable equipment sources.
steps.warning: Register all Godrick Soldier and Knight drops now; do not remain for a lengthy RNG farm.

steps.instruction: Enter the cellar and open the chest containing the Whetstone Knife and Ash of War: Storm Stomp.
Open the northern carriage chest and collect the Lordsworn's Greatsword.
Open the southern carriage chest and collect the Flail.
Confirm Torrent, leveling, Renna's rewards, the map fragment, both carriage weapons, and the cellar rewards are complete.
steps.warning: Farmable enemy drops may remain registered and deferred.

steps.instruction: Activate Agheel Lake North Site of Grace to establish the southern Gatefront exit and next-route access.
steps.warning: This grace is the starting point for the West Limgrave night and southern-lake packages.

steps.instruction: Verify Gatefront's map, two carriage weapons, cellar rewards, all farm-source registrations, and Agheel Lake North grace before closing Objective 3.
Ride northwest from Church of Elleh, activate Groveside Cave Site of Grace, and equip the Torch before entering.
Loot the Cracked Pot beneath the first ledge near the wolves' camp.
Loot Glowstone x3 from the corpse in the main wolf chamber.
Loot Golden Rune [1] from the remaining corpse in the wolf chamber.
Clear the wolf pack and proceed to the boss fog.
Defeat Beastman of Farum Azula.
Confirm receipt of the Flamedrake Talisman.
Complete the Groveside Cave micro-validation.
Ride west from Church of Elleh, enter Stormfoot Catacombs, and activate the Site of Grace.
Clear the first imp ambush and collect Root Resin ×2 and the first Grave Glovewort [1].
Collect Prattling Pate "Hello" from the fire-trap corridor.
steps.warning: Disable or bait the flame pillar before committing to the pickup.

steps.instruction: Collect Smoldering Butterfly ×3, Grave Violet ×1, and the remaining three Grave Glovewort [1] placements while clearing the fire-trap route.
Collect Ghost Glovewort [1] from the lower route.
Use the rising-floor trap to reach the upper ledge and collect Wandering Noble Ashes.
Register Fanged Imps as the West Limgrave source for Imp Head (Fanged) without remaining to farm it.
Reach and pull the lever that opens the boss door, then return to the grace-side corridor.
Defeat the Erdtree Burial Watchdog.
Confirm receipt of Noble Sorcerer Ashes.
Verify all eight Stormfoot collection records, the boss, the grace, and the Imp Head farm registration.
Ride north through the Murkwater ravine toward the invasion trigger; keep enough healing available for an NPC invasion.
Defeat Bloody Finger Nerijus; allow Bloody Finger Hunter Yura to join naturally and collect Reduvia.
steps.warning: Do not leave the ravine after the invasion triggers; Yura arrives after a short delay.

steps.instruction: Speak with Yura beneath the ruined overhang after Nerijus and exhaust his available dialogue.
Enter Murkwater Cave and activate its Site of Grace.
Clear the highwaymen and register Highwayman Hood, Cloth Armor, Gauntlets, Dagger, and Short Sword as later farm targets.
steps.warning: Do not remain for an extended RNG farm.

steps.instruction: Open the boss-room chest, collect Cloth Garb and Cloth Trousers, and fight Patches until he surrenders at roughly half health.
steps.warning: Stop attacking immediately when Patches surrenders; killing him permanently forfeits his quest, gestures, and future inventory.

steps.instruction: Spare Patches, receive Grovel for Mercy and Golden Rune [1], and exhaust his surrender dialogue.
Rest once, return to Patches, exhaust his merchant dialogue, and register Glass Shard as an infinite-stock source.
Buy Margit's Shackle, Missionary's Cookbook [2], Parrying Dagger, Estoc, and Horse Crest Wooden Shield.

Buy Patches' complete finite Murkwater stock: Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot ×3, Fan Daggers ×20, Grace Mimic ×15, Furlcalling Finger Remedy ×3, Festering Bloody Finger ×5, Stonesword Key ×1, Great Arrow ×10, Ballista Bolt ×5, and Sacrificial Twig ×1.
steps.warning: This is the remaining 29,000 runes of Patches' 40,400-rune Murkwater closeout.

steps.instruction: After Patches is friendly, deliberately strike him until he becomes hostile, allow him to reduce your health until he prompts surrender, then use Grovel for Mercy to receive Extreme Repentance and restore peace.
steps.warning: Use controlled weak attacks and stop immediately once hostility is triggered. Do not kill Patches.

steps.instruction: After Patches is friendly again, open his teleporter-trap chest and allow it to send you to Mistwood.
steps.warning: Do not begin the East Limgrave sweep from the trap destination.

steps.instruction: Escape the Runebear area, rest at a Site of Grace to clear the transport lock, and fast travel back to Murkwater Cave.
Confront Patches about the trap, receive Calm Down!, and exhaust his remaining Murkwater dialogue.
Verify Reduvia, all three Patches gestures, both Cloth pieces, complete merchant closeout, Yura dialogue, and Patches alive and friendly.
Enter Murkwater Catacombs and activate the Site of Grace.
Collect Root Resin ×5 while clearing the first imp corridors.
Collect both Grave Glovewort [1] placements and Ghost Glovewort [1].
Register Fanged Imps as a second Act I source for Imp Head (Fanged) without stopping to farm.
Complete the lever route and return to the boss door.
Defeat the Grave Warden Duelist.
Confirm receipt of Banished Knight Engvall Ashes.
Verify every fixed catacomb pickup, the boss reward, grace, lever, and Imp Head source registration.
Rest at Agheel Lake North and pass time to night.
Defeat the Agheel Lake North Night's Cavalry and obtain Ash of War: Repeating Thrust.
Destroy the visible white Teardrop Scarab on the bridge southeast of Agheel Lake North and obtain Ash of War: Determination.
Ride to the Kaiden camp northeast of Agheel Lake North, clear it, and collect Armorer's Cookbook [1].
Register the Kaiden set and Dismounter from the camp without remaining for a lengthy farm.
During the return sweep, register Godrick Foot Soldier, Wandering Noble, Noble Sorcerer, and Land Octopus equipment sources without forcing RNG completion.
Verify Repeating Thrust, Determination, Armorer's Cookbook [1], and all field farm-source registrations.
Ride south from Agheel Lake North and destroy the visible white Teardrop Scarab northwest of Agheel Lake South to obtain Ash of War: Unsheathe.
Clear the surface of Dragon-Burnt Ruins and locate the two separate cellar entrances.
Use Torrent to enter the non-trap cellar and collect the Twinblade.
steps.warning: Do not open the trapped transport chest in the other cellar during this West Limgrave package.

steps.instruction: Ride southeast of Agheel Lake South, clear the small enemy camp, and open the chest containing the Great Épée.
Verify Unsheathe, Twinblade, Great Épée, the safe Dragon-Burnt cellar, and the preserved transport chest.
Return to the western coast below the Stranded Graveyard and begin a south-to-north shoreline sweep.
Reach the secluded beach below the Stranded Graveyard and collect the Haligdrake Talisman.
Defeat the Alabaster Lord on the southern beach and obtain Ash of War: Gravitas.
Intercept the invisible white scarab's glowing trail west of Stormfoot Catacombs and obtain Ash of War: Stamp (Sweep).
steps.warning: Stand across the glowing footprint loop and attack slightly ahead of the trail.

steps.instruction: Meet the Nomadic Merchant on the western beach, exhaust his greeting, and register infinite Arrow and Bolt stock.
Buy Neutralizing Boluses ×5, Stanching Boluses ×3, Stimulating Boluses ×2, and Smithing Stone [1] ×3.
Buy Armorer's Cookbook [2], Broadsword, Club, Shortbow, and Iron Roundshield.
Buy Note: Land Squirts and Note: Stonedigger Trolls.
Verify all three western-coast rewards and the Nomadic Merchant's complete thirteen-line inventory and 13,500-rune closeout.
Locate the disguised Boc near the road southeast of Agheel Lake North, strike or roll into the shrub, and exhaust his dialogue.
steps.warning: Do not repeatedly attack after the disguise breaks.

steps.instruction: Ride to the western beach and activate Coastal Cave Site of Grace.
Speak with injured Boc inside Coastal Cave and exhaust his dialogue.
Clear the Demi-Human groups while descending through Coastal Cave.
Defeat both Demi-Human Chiefs.
Confirm receipt of the Tailoring Tools and Sewing Needle.
Continue through the rear tunnel and emerge on the island containing the Church of Dragon Communion.
Collect Exalted Flesh from the Dragon Communion island.
Collect the fixed Smithing Stone [2] on the island.
Destroy the visible white scarab behind the Church of Dragon Communion and collect Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Activate the Church of Dragon Communion Site of Grace, inspect the altar, and register Dragonfire, Dragonclaw, and Dragonmaw without spending the single available Act I Dragon Heart.
steps.warning: One Agheel heart cannot buy all three incantations. The first-heart choice remains deferred to the build plan.

steps.instruction: Return to Coastal Cave and give Boc the Sewing Needle; exhaust his dialogue.
Complete the Boc and Coastal Cave micro-validation.
Enter Limgrave Tunnels from the northwestern edge of Agheel Lake and activate its Site of Grace.
Mine every visible Smithing Stone [1] deposit in the first galleries.
steps.warning: Use strike damage or two-hand attacks against miners.

steps.instruction: Continue the full tunnel sweep until all nine placed Smithing Stone [1] deposits are collected.
Collect the Golden Rune [1] from the side-platform corpse during the lift descent.
steps.warning: Step off the lift onto the side ledge rather than riding directly to the bottom.

steps.instruction: Drop to the lower side platform and collect Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Collect all placed Glintstone Scrap and Large Glintstone Scrap encountered on the full tunnel route.
Clear the miner chambers and reach the bottom boss door.
Defeat the Stonedigger Troll.
Confirm receipt of the Roar Medallion.
Use the collected stones only according to the active weapon-upgrade plan; do not spend Somber Smithing Stone [1] casually.
steps.location: Church of Elleh or Roundtable Hold

steps.instruction: Complete the Limgrave Tunnels micro-validation and confirm all tracked deposits are exhausted.
Return to The First Step, spend excess runes, and prepare for mounted or on-foot combat against the Tree Sentinel.
Defeat the Tree Sentinel on the road to Church of Elleh.
Confirm receipt of the Golden Halberd.
Verify every West Limgrave permanent collectible, finite pickup, merchant closeout, NPC state, encounter, traversal unlock, and all four regional reward scarabs.
steps.warning: Bloodhound Knight Darriwil is intentionally assigned to East Limgrave after meeting Blaidd; Fringefolk Hero's Grave is intentionally assigned to Global 16.

steps.instruction: Verify all forty-two West Limgrave farm targets have valid sources registered; no lengthy RNG session is required for regional certification.
Complete the West Limgrave objective and completion-unit certification, then prepare to enter East Limgrave.
steps.warning: The next production package is East Limgrave. Fringefolk Hero's Grave remains reserved for Global 16.

steps.instruction: From the completed West Limgrave route, ride northeast through the lake corridor to the Third Church of Marika before beginning the wider eastern sweep.
steps.location: West Limgrave to Third Church of Marika

steps.instruction: Enter the Third Church of Marika and activate its Site of Grace.
Collect the Flask of Wondrous Physick and Sacred Tear from inside the church.
Collect the Crimson Crystal Tear from the stone basin beside the church.
Ride behind the church, locate the sending gate, and register it for the later Deathroot delivery without using it yet.
steps.warning: Do not use the sending gate before obtaining the first Deathroot.

steps.instruction: Destroy the visible white Teardrop Scarab northwest of the church and obtain Ash of War: Sacred Blade.
steps.location: Northwest of Third Church of Marika

steps.instruction: Verify the church grace, Wondrous Physick, Sacred Tear, Crimson Crystal Tear, Sacred Blade, and the unused sending gate.
Ride south along the eastern edge of Lake Agheel toward the incline east of Agheel Lake South.
Defeat the Wandering Noble that transforms into a Runebear and collect the guaranteed Larval Tear.
steps.warning: The transformation creates a powerful Runebear; use Torrent and open terrain.
steps.location: Incline east of Agheel Lake South

steps.instruction: Visit the nearby stone astrolabe and collect the Starlight Shard.
steps.location: Astrolabe southeast of Agheel Lake South

steps.instruction: Climb the ruined building east of the lake and collect the Royal House Scroll.
steps.location: Ruined building east of Agheel Lake South

steps.instruction: Verify the Larval Tear, Starlight Shard, and Royal House Scroll before entering Waypoint Ruins.
Ride north to Waypoint Ruins, clear a safe path through the Poison Flowers, and locate the cellar entrance.
Enter the cellar and defeat the Mad Pumpkin Head guarding Sorceress Sellen.
Activate the Waypoint Ruins Cellar Site of Grace.
Meet Sorceress Sellen, exhaust her introduction, accept her apprenticeship, and preserve her quest.
steps.warning: Do not attack Sellen or her imprisoned body in Witchbane Ruins.

steps.instruction: Purchase Sellen's six initial sorceries: Glintstone Pebble, Glintstone Stars, Glintstone Arc, Crystal Barrage, Scholar's Armament, and Scholar's Shield.
Give Sellen the Royal House Scroll and exhaust the new dialogue.
Purchase Carian Slicer and Glintblade Phalanx from the expanded inventory.
Register the Mad Pumpkin Head as an Act I source for the Pumpkin Helm without remaining for an RNG farm.
steps.warning: Source registration completes the regional requirement; the rare drop may be farmed later.

steps.instruction: Verify all eight Sellen sorceries are purchased and the complete 16,500-rune Act I inventory is closed.
Return to Lake Agheel, spend excess runes, and prepare for the open-field dragon encounter.
Defeat Flying Dragon Agheel in Lake Agheel.
Confirm receipt of the Dragon Heart.

Record that one Dragon Heart is available while Dragonfire, Dragonclaw, and Dragonmaw remain registered at the Church of Dragon Communion; do not spend the heart until the active build plan chooses an option.
steps.warning: One Act I heart cannot purchase all three communion incantations.
steps.location: Lake Agheel / Church of Dragon Communion

steps.instruction: Verify Sub-Objectives 1.A–1.D, all Third Church rewards, southern-lake secrets, Sellen's inventory, Agheel, and the preserved Dragon Heart decision.
Ride east from the Third Church corridor and activate the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace.
Collect Map: Limgrave, East from the map stele north-northeast of Mistwood Ruins.
Collect Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [4] from the corpse beside the Lesser Runebear near the map stele.
steps.warning: Avoid provoking the nearby Runebear unless necessary.

steps.instruction: Approach Mistwood Ruins and listen for Blaidd's howl from the tower.
Enter the ruins cellar and collect the Axe Talisman while avoiding the sleeping Runebear.
Fast travel to the Church of Elleh, ask Kalé about the howling, and receive Finger Snap.
Return to Mistwood Ruins, use Finger Snap beneath Blaidd, and exhaust his dialogue until he requests Darriwil's defeat.
steps.warning: Do not attack Blaidd.

steps.instruction: Verify the eastern map, Cookbook [4], howl, Axe Talisman, Finger Snap, and Blaidd's Darriwil request.
Ride southwest to Forlorn Hound Evergaol immediately after Blaidd's introduction.
Enter the Evergaol and summon Blaidd from the golden sign before awakening Darriwil.
steps.warning: Summon Blaidd to preserve the intended quest interaction.

steps.instruction: Defeat Bloodhound Knight Darriwil with Blaidd's assistance.
Confirm receipt of Bloodhound's Fang.
Speak with Blaidd outside the Evergaol, exhaust his post-fight dialogue, and receive Somber Smithing Stone [2].
Verify Blaidd was summoned, Darriwil is defeated, Bloodhound's Fang and Somber Smithing Stone [2] are acquired, and the future Iji dialogue is preserved.
Ride east through Mistwood to the Limgrave Minor Erdtree.
Collect the Greenspill Crystal Tear and Spiked Cracked Tear from the stone basin at the tree's base.
steps.warning: There is no Erdtree Avatar at the Limgrave Minor Erdtree.

steps.instruction: Sweep the basin and surrounding scarabs, confirming that the Limgrave Minor Erdtree has no Erdtree Guardian farm source.
Destroy the visible white scarab southwest of the tree and obtain Ash of War: Ground Slam.
Confirm the obsolete Limgrave Erdtree Avatar draft is removed and no boss reward is expected here.
Verify both fixed Crystal Tears, Ground Slam, the absence of an Erdtree Avatar, and the absence of Erdtree Guardian farm sources.
Follow the eastern Mistwood road to the Nomadic Merchant and begin the northern coastal loop.
Meet the Nomadic Merchant, exhaust his greeting, and register infinite Arrow and Bolt stock.
Buy all finite materials and ammunition: Festering Bloody Finger ×5, Sliver of Meat ×5, Beast Liver ×5, Lump of Flesh ×3, Trina's Lily ×3, Smithing Stone [1] ×3, and St. Trina's Arrow ×10.
Buy Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [5], Armorer's Cookbook [3], Hand Axe, Riveted Wooden Shield, and Blue-Gold Kite Shield.
Ride north to the western cliff above the merchant and collect Golden Rune [1] from the corpse guarded by stray dogs.
steps.location: Cliff north of Eastern Mistwood merchant

steps.instruction: Continue along the coastal cliff and collect the non-respawning Trina's Lily.
Reach the elevated graveyard north of Mistwood near Kenneth's ruin and collect Fevor's Cookbook [1].
Verify the merchant's complete fourteen-line inventory and the 23,300-rune finite and one-stock closeout.
Locate the Siofra River Well structure on Mistwood's eastern edge and register the surface access.
Ride the Siofra River Well lift to the underground region.
Activate the Siofra River Well Depths Site of Grace.
Return immediately to the surface and preserve the full Siofra River route for its dedicated future Completion Unit.
steps.warning: Do not begin the underground collection sweep.

steps.instruction: Verify the eastern map, Blaidd and Darriwil sequence, Minor Erdtree fixed rewards, both East reward scarabs, merchant closeout, northern pickups, and Siofra discovery.
Verify the valid East Limgrave farm target, Pumpkin Helm, has a registered source; Guardian equipment is assigned to the Weeping Peninsula Minor Erdtree.
Complete Objective 2 and proceed to Kenneth Haight and Fort Haight.
Meet Kenneth Haight on the ruined overpass north of Mistwood, exhaust his dialogue, and accept the Fort Haight request.
steps.warning: Do not attack Kenneth.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Ride southeast to Fort Haight, activate the Fort Haight West Site of Grace, and collect the Golden Seed.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Clear the outer approach and defeat the Mad Pumpkin Head guarding the fort entrance.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Collect Bloodrose ×3 in the entrance courtyard.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Enter the courtyard room and collect Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [6] and Smithing Stone [1].
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Clear the courtyard and climb the battlements, collecting Bloodrose ×5 along the upper route.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Defeat the Godrick Knight on the battlements and obtain Ash of War: Bloody Slash.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Climb the tower and open the chest containing Dectus Medallion (Left).
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Verify Fort Haight is cleared and the commander is defeated.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Return to Kenneth, report the fort cleared, receive the Erdsteel Dagger, and exhaust his dialogue.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Verify Kenneth's first arc, Golden Seed, Cookbook [6], all fixed Fort Haight resources, Bloody Slash, Dectus Medallion Left, and Erdsteel Dagger.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Travel north toward Summonwater Village, speak with D, Hunter of the Dead, and exhaust his warning.
steps.warning: Do not attack D.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Activate the Summonwater Village Outskirts Site of Grace.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Collect the three non-respawning Trina's Lilies among the flooded ruins.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Defeat the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Confirm receipt of Deathroot #1 and Skeletal Militiaman Ashes.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Spend one Stonesword Key to open the village cellar and collect the Green Turtle Talisman.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Sweep the graveyard north of the village and collect Golden Rune [1] ×3, Golden Rune [2] ×1, Golden Rune [4] ×2, and Golden Rune [6] ×1.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Speak with D after obtaining Deathroot and accept his introduction to Gurranq and the Third Church sending gate.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Verify D's dialogue, Tibia Mariner, both boss rewards, key consumption, Green Turtle Talisman, lilies, and the complete graveyard rune sweep.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Fast travel to the Third Church and use the sending gate to reach the Bestial Sanctum.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Enter the Bestial Sanctum, meet Gurranq, and offer the first Deathroot.
steps.warning: Do not attack Gurranq.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Confirm receipt of the Beast Eye and Clawmark Seal.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Activate the Bestial Sanctum Site of Grace.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Return to Limgrave without exploring Dragonbarrow; preserve the Deathtouched Catacombs Deathroot and Bestial Sling for the authoritative Stormhill package.
steps.warning: Do not begin the Dragonbarrow collection route.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Verify the first Deathroot delivery, Beast Eye, Clawmark Seal, sanctum grace, and the explicit Stormhill handoff for the second delivery.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Confirm Deathtouched Catacombs, Uchigatana, Assassin's Crimson Dagger, Deathroot #2, and Bestial Sling are assigned only to the authoritative Stormhill package.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Verify every East Limgrave permanent collectible, finite pickup, merchant line, NPC state, encounter, traversal record, farm source, and both reward scarabs.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Mark East Limgrave production-complete and prepare to cross the Bridge of Sacrifice into the Weeping Peninsula.
steps.objectiveName: Secure Fort Haight and Open the Bestial Sanctum

steps.instruction: Approach the Bridge of Sacrifice from Agheel Lake South and clear the soldiers, ballista crew, and immediate bridge defenders.
steps.warning: Use Torrent or the bridge cover to avoid prolonged exposure to the ballista.

steps.instruction: Collect the Stonesword Key from the seated corpse behind the bridge ballista.
Cross into the Weeping Peninsula and activate the Bridge of Sacrifice Site of Grace.
Follow the road just south of the bridge and collect the fixed Trina's Lily before continuing to Irina.
steps.warning: This non-respawning lily is easy to pass while approaching Irina.
steps.location: Road south of Bridge of Sacrifice
steps.returnWindow: Before leaving the Journey South corridor

steps.instruction: Follow the road south of the grace, meet Irina, and exhaust her initial dialogue.
steps.warning: Do not attack Irina. Complete this interaction before resolving Castle Morne.

steps.instruction: Accept Irina's request and receive Irina's Letter for delivery to Castellan Edgar.
steps.warning: The letter is the required handoff for Edgar's Castle Morne progression.

steps.instruction: Ride south from Irina toward the broken-carriage camp, clearing the roadside soldiers without bypassing the fixed pickups.
steps.warning: Side routes, dungeons, churches, and field bosses belong to Objective 2.
steps.location: Road south of Irina / broken-carriage camp

steps.instruction: Loot the corpse at the roadside camp for Strip of White Flesh.
steps.returnWindow: Before leaving the Journey South corridor

steps.instruction: Open the chest in the broken carriage and obtain the Morning Star.
steps.warning: This fixed bleed weapon was omitted from the legacy route.
steps.returnWindow: Before leaving the Journey South corridor

steps.instruction: Sweep the camp and collect the placed Golden Rune [2] and Smithing Stone [2].
steps.returnWindow: Before leaving the Journey South corridor

steps.instruction: Ride northwest of Castle Morne Rampart, kill the visible white Teardrop Scarab, and obtain Ash of War: Mighty Shot.
steps.warning: This is a permanent-item scarab; do not confuse it with flask-refill scarabs.

steps.instruction: Collect the fixed Arteria Leaf on the rise beside the southern road before establishing the rampart hub.
steps.location: Roadside rise north of Castle Morne Rampart

steps.instruction: Activate the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace to establish the peninsula's central expedition hub.
Meet the Nomadic Merchant beside the grace, exhaust his greeting, and register his complete finite and one-stock inventory.
steps.warning: Do not kill the merchant; his bell bearing is unnecessary for this route.

steps.instruction: Purchase the Cracked Pot, Stonesword Key, Bastard Sword, Light Crossbow, Red Thorn Roundshield, Round Shield, Iron Helmet, Scale Armor, Iron Gauntlets, Leather Trousers, Crimson Amber Medallion, and Note: Demi-human Mobs.
steps.warning: Total one-stock permanent-inventory cost: 17,600 runes. Use stored Golden Runes if needed rather than leveling beyond the planned tier.

steps.instruction: Buy the merchant's full finite stock: Smithing Stone [1] ×3, Smithing Stone [2] ×1, Great Arrow ×8, and Ballista Bolt ×8.
steps.warning: Total finite-stock cost: 5,800 runes.

steps.instruction: Register the merchant's infinite Kukri, Arrow, and Bolt stock as renewable sources; do not attempt to buy out infinite inventory.
steps.warning: Source registration is complete without purchasing an arbitrary quantity.
steps.returnWindow: Any time before merchant bell-bearing acquisition

steps.instruction: Continue south past the rampart grace and collect Map: Weeping Peninsula from the roadside map stele.
steps.warning: Do not continue into Castle Morne; the castle is the regional finale in Objective 3.
steps.location: Map stele south of Castle Morne Rampart

steps.instruction: Run the Journey South audit: verify both graces, roadside Trina's Lily, Irina's Letter, the camp's Morning Star and fixed resources, Mighty Shot scarab, complete rampart merchant closeout and infinite-stock registration, and Map: Weeping Peninsula.
steps.warning: Objective 2 begins only after all required records are complete.

steps.instruction: Use the nearby spiritspring to reach the tower above the rampart road.
Collect the Great Turtle Shell from the tower.
Loot the tower platform for Warming Stone ×2 before dropping back to the road.
Return to the main road and ride northeast to South of the Lookout Tower.
Activate the South of the Lookout Tower Site of Grace.
Clear Forest Lookout Tower and its surrounding defenders.
Climb Forest Lookout Tower and collect the Hand Ballista and Ballista Bolt ×5 from the upper platform.
Sweep the graveyard beside Forest Lookout Tower and collect all six placed Golden Rune [1] pickups.
Ride east and activate Beside the Crater-Pocked Glade Site of Grace.
Reach Oridys's Rise, read the imp seal, and locate all three wise beasts.
steps.warning: One beast is invisible; strike the disturbance in the pond.

steps.instruction: Enter Oridys's Rise and collect the Memory Stone.
Collect the Starlight Shard from the stone basin outside Oridys's Rise.
Ride to the nearby cliff ledge and collect the fixed Stonesword Key before leaving the eastern plateau.
Ride north from Oridys's Rise and follow the Rosus statue toward Impaler's Catacombs.
Activate the Impaler's Catacombs Site of Grace.
Complete the first catacomb chambers and collect Grave Glovewort [1] ×3, Grave Glovewort [2] ×3, Ghost Glovewort [2], and Root Resin ×3.
Collect Prattling Pate "Please help" from the first flooded room, then complete the rising-floor trap route.
Defeat the Erdtree Burial Watchdog and accompanying imps.
Confirm receipt of the Demi-Human Ashes.
Exit and sweep the eastern beach and cliff line for fixed pickups before leaving the coast.
Return west toward the central forest and enter Demi-Human Forest Ruins.
Clear the outer demi-human groups and defeat the Demi-Human Queen.
Collect the Demi-Human Queen's Staff and Crystal Burst.
Sweep Demi-Human Forest Ruins for Arteria Leaf ×3, Gold-Tinged Excrement ×2, String ×5, and Golden Rune [2].
Collect the Shield of the Guilty from the corpse in Demi-Human Forest Ruins.
steps.warning: The legacy workbook incorrectly placed this shield in Ailing Village.

steps.instruction: Register the Demi-Human Forest Ruins sources for Falchion, Rickety Shield, and Spiked Club; continue the route without remaining to farm.
steps.warning: Farm completion is tracked separately from fixed regional certification.

steps.instruction: Follow the nearby spectral candle's spirit trail to Earthbore Cave.
On the Earthbore Cave approach, collect Rainbow Stone ×6 and Pickled Turtle Neck ×3 from the fixed corpses.
Activate the Earthbore Cave Site of Grace.
Trigger the collapsing floor and sweep the rat chambers for Golden Rune [1], Glowstone ×5, Kukri ×8, Smoldering Butterfly ×5, and the fixed Trina's Lily.
Defeat the Runebear at the end of Earthbore Cave.
Confirm receipt of the Spelldrake Talisman.
Return to South of the Lookout Tower and ride southwest toward Ailing Village.
Enter Ailing Village and clear the frenzied villagers systematically.
steps.warning: Avoid being surrounded; frenzy buildup can interrupt healing.

steps.instruction: Enter the village house and collect the Flame Crest Wooden Shield.
Register Ailing Village and the nearby cliffs as sources for Guilty Hood and Misbegotten Shortbow; do not remain to farm.
Continue uphill to Callu Baptismal Church.
Clear the church interior and graveyard of rats and the giant rat.
Collect the Sacred Tear from Callu Baptismal Church.
Collect The Flame of Frenzy incantation from the corpse inside Callu Baptismal Church.
Search the church perimeter and graveyard for remaining fixed pickups.
Descend carefully toward the lightning field southwest of the church.
Kill the visible white Teardrop Scarab and obtain the Lightning Strike incantation.
steps.warning: Do not confuse this permanent-item scarab with crimson or cerulean flask-refill scarabs.

steps.instruction: Verify Packages A-D: both eastern graces, Oridys's Rise, Impaler's Catacombs, Demi-Human Forest Ruins, Earthbore Cave, Ailing Village, and Callu Baptismal Church.
steps.warning: Castle Morne remains untouched; Packages E-N remain under Objective 2.

steps.instruction: Ride from Callu Baptismal Church toward Morne Tunnel and clear the approach.
Enter Morne Tunnel and activate its Site of Grace.
Equip strike damage or another miner-effective option before beginning the mine sweep.
Sweep the first mining chambers and collect all nine fixed Smithing Stone [1] deposits.
Collect Golden Rune [2], Golden Rune [4], and Exalted Flesh from the tunnel side passages.
Collect all three fixed Somber Smithing Stone [1] deposits.
Complete the lower sweep for Large Glintstone Scrap ×2, Stanching Boluses, Arteria Leaf ×2, and Soft Cotton.
Register the Tunnel Miner as the Pickaxe source; do not remain to farm.
Defeat the Scaly Misbegotten in the final chamber.
Confirm receipt of the Rusted Anchor.

Exit the tunnel, verify the full fixed list (Smithing Stone [1] ×9, Somber Smithing Stone [1] ×3, both runes, Exalted Flesh, and all side materials), then allocate stones only according to the active weapon-upgrade plan.
steps.warning: Avoid spending limited stones on temporary weapons.

steps.instruction: Ride north to the Church of Pilgrimage.
Use the spiritspring route toward the church plateau and collect all five fixed Trina's Lilies.
steps.location: Spiritspring route to Church of Pilgrimage

steps.instruction: Collect the Faith-knot Crystal Tear from the stone basin north of Demi-Human Forest Ruins.
steps.location: Stone basin below Church of Pilgrimage plateau

steps.instruction: Continue along the Church of Pilgrimage route and collect the fixed Sliver of Meat and Bewitching Branch ×3.
Activate the Church of Pilgrimage Site of Grace.
Collect the Sacred Tear inside the church.
Speak with the nearby spirit and exhaust its Walking Mausoleum dialogue.
Rest at the grace and hear Melina's optional spoken echo of Queen Marika.
steps.warning: Rest at the grace while Melina's dialogue option is available.

steps.instruction: Sweep the churchyard for Golden Centipede ×5, Blood Grease ×2, and the Gilded Iron Shield.
Ride south from the church toward the Minor Erdtree and clear the guardian approach.
Clear the Erdtree Guardians without pulling the Avatar prematurely.
Register the Erdtree Guardians as sources for Guardian Mask, Garb, Bracers, Greaves, and Guardian's Swordspear; continue without farming.
Defeat the Erdtree Avatar.
Confirm receipt of the Opaline Bubbletear and Crimsonburst Crystal Tear.
Descend the western side of the Minor Erdtree plateau and collect the fixed Sliver of Meat.
Continue to the stone arch northwest of the Minor Erdtree and collect the Eclipse Crest Heater Shield.
steps.location: Stone arch northwest of Minor Erdtree

steps.instruction: Sweep the raised ridge and certify the Church of Pilgrimage / Minor Erdtree package.
Kill the visible white Teardrop Scarab at the collapsed structure west of Tombsward Ruins and obtain Divine Fortification.
steps.warning: Permanent reward scarab; route it individually.

steps.instruction: Ride west into Tombsward Ruins and clear the surface enemies.
Sweep Tombsward Ruins for all five Trina's Lilies and the fixed Beast Liver.
Locate the underground stairway and search the remaining ruined structures.
Open the underground chest and obtain the Winged Scythe.
Ride to Weeping Evergaol and confirm one Stonesword Key is available.
steps.warning: Opening the Evergaol consumes one Stonesword Key.

steps.instruction: Use one Stonesword Key to open Weeping Evergaol.
Enter and defeat the Ancient Hero of Zamor.
steps.warning: Adaptive defer allowed only if the active weapon is severely under-upgraded.

steps.instruction: Confirm receipt of Radagon's Scarseal.
Ride south of Weeping Evergaol and collect the three fixed Trina's Lilies.
Certify Tombsward Ruins and Weeping Evergaol, or record the Evergaol as an explicit regional-audit deferral.
steps.warning: A silent skip is not allowed.

steps.instruction: Activate the Tombsward Site of Grace.
Follow the Rosus statue to Tombsward Catacombs.
Activate the Tombsward Catacombs Site of Grace.
Clear the skeleton route and flame trap while collecting Grave Glovewort [1] ×3, Grave Glovewort [2] ×3, Ghost Glovewort [1], Human Bone Shard ×5, Golden Rune [2], and Grave Violet.
Spend one Stonesword Key to open the imp seal and obtain Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [9].
Collect Prattling Pate "Thank you" from the room beside the flame pillar.
Pull the lever and return to the boss door.
Defeat the Cemetery Shade.
Confirm receipt of Lhutel the Headless.
Proceed to Tombsward Cave and prepare poison-curing consumables.
Activate the Tombsward Cave Site of Grace.
Clear Tombsward Cave's poison chambers and collect Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [8], Golden Rune [2], Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Immunizing White Cured Meat, Arteria Leaf, and Poisonbone Dart ×6.
steps.warning: Monitor poison buildup and cure before the boss if needed.

steps.instruction: Defeat Miranda the Blighted Bloom.
Confirm receipt of the Viridian Amber Medallion.
Verify Packages E-H and preserve the route for Packages I-N without entering Castle Morne.
steps.warning: Castle Morne remains untouched.

steps.instruction: Ride west from Tombsward to the Walking Mausoleum field.
Bring down the Walking Mausoleum by clearing the skull deposits from its legs.
steps.warning: Do not duplicate a Remembrance yet unless the duplication plan specifically calls for it.

steps.instruction: Register the Weeping Mausoleum soldiers and knights as sources for Lordsworn's Shield, Heavy Crossbow, Mausoleum Surcoat, Mausoleum Gauntlets, Mausoleum Greaves, Mausoleum Knight Armor, Mausoleum Knight Gauntlets, Mausoleum Knight Greaves, Knight's Greatsword, Eclipse Crest Greatshield, and Greatbow; do not remain to farm.
Enter the Mausoleum, register the duplication interface, and leave it unused.
Ride uphill to the Fourth Church of Marika.
Activate the Fourth Church of Marika Site of Grace.
Collect the Sacred Tear inside the church.
Clear the churchyard and surrounding Mausoleum Soldiers, then collect fixed pickups.
Descend south into the poison basin and enter Witchbane Ruins.
steps.warning: Prepare poison mitigation before crossing the basin.

steps.instruction: Sweep Witchbane Ruins for the fixed Great Dragonfly Head and Trina's Lily before opening the cellar.
Collect the Ambush Shard sorcery from the cellar beside imprisoned Sellen.
steps.warning: Do not harm Sellen's imprisoned body.

steps.instruction: Open the cellar, register Sorceress Sellen's imprisoned body, and exhaust only the currently available dialogue.
steps.warning: Do not attack the body or attempt to force later quest progression.

steps.instruction: Register Witchbane Ruins as the farm source for Marionette Soldier Helm, Marionette Soldier Armor, and Spiked Spear; continue without farming.
Certify the Mausoleum, Fourth Church, Sacred Tear, and Witchbane quest-state package.
Ride southwest to the Isolated Merchant's Shack.
Activate the Isolated Merchant's Shack Site of Grace.
Meet the Isolated Merchant, exhaust his greeting, and register the full shop.
Purchase the Lantern, Lost Ashes of War, Zweihander, and Note: Wandering Mausoleum.
steps.warning: Permanent one-stock subtotal: 8,900 runes.

steps.instruction: Purchase all three Stonesword Keys and all three Smithing Stone [2].
steps.warning: Finite progression-stock subtotal: 7,200 runes.

steps.instruction: Purchase all five Festering Bloody Fingers and all five Arteria Leaves.
steps.warning: Finite consumable subtotal: 10,000 runes.

steps.instruction: Purchase all fifteen Great Arrows, all fifteen Ballista Bolts, and all three Sacrificial Twigs.
steps.warning: Finite-stock subtotal: 18,000 runes.

steps.instruction: Confirm all limited stock is exhausted; infinite Arrows and Bolts do not require closeout purchases.
Sweep the western coast for Golden Rune [5], Golden Rune [1], and the fixed Golden Rune [2] on the northeastern beach.
Clear the western graveyard and coast, collecting Golden Rune [1] ×4, Golden Rune [2], Golden Rune [3], Great Dragonfly Head ×3, and Mushroom ×4.
Certify the merchant and western-coast package before entering the Tower of Return sequence.
Ride southeast to the Tower of Return and clear the soldiers around the tower.
Climb the Tower of Return and open the trapped chest at the summit.
steps.warning: The chest transports you to the Divine Bridge in Leyndell.

steps.instruction: Arrive at the Divine Bridge and activate the Site of Grace immediately.
Avoid or defeat the Guardian Golem according to current readiness; the talisman chest remains the priority.
steps.warning: Defeating this golem is not required for regional completion.

steps.instruction: Open the chest west of the grace and obtain the Blessed Dew Talisman.
Inspect the sealed route only far enough to document the early Leyndell boundary.
steps.warning: Do not attempt capital exploration from this reconnaissance visit.

steps.instruction: Fast-travel back to the Weeping Peninsula immediately.
Certify Tower of Return, Divine Bridge grace, Blessed Dew Talisman, and the no-exploration boundary.
Return to the southern road and ride toward Castle Morne without entering the castle.
Kill the visible white Teardrop Scarab north of the poison pool, south of Castle Morne Rampart, and obtain the Poison Mist incantation.
steps.warning: This reward is the Poison Mist incantation, not Ash of War: Poisonous Mist.
steps.location: North of poison pool / south of Castle Morne Rampart

steps.instruction: Collect the Smithing Stone [1] from the ruined wall on the Castle Morne approach.
Sweep the approach swamp for Golden Rune [4].
Ride the eastern approach and collect Somber Smithing Stone [2], Arteria Leaf, and the fixed Trina's Lily.
Collect the Golden Seed from the spectral sapling on the approach.
Sweep the beach east of Castle Morne and collect the fixed Golden Rune [1].
Clear the approach enemies and secure the lift entrance area.
Activate the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace.
steps.warning: Do not ride the lift or begin Castle Morne during Objective 2.

steps.instruction: Verify Poison Mist, all fixed Castle Morne approach resources, the Golden Seed, eastern beach rune, Castle Morne Lift grace, and the strict no-entry boundary with Edgar still uncontacted.
steps.warning: Objective 3 begins from this exact state.

steps.instruction: Return to Castle Morne Rampart and pass time until nightfall.
Defeat the Night's Cavalry patrolling the road near the rampart grace.
Confirm receipt of the Nightrider Flail and Ash of War: Barricade Shield.
Remain at night and travel to the Deathbird encounter area north of Castle Morne.
steps.warning: Do not reset the time between night encounters.

steps.instruction: Collect the fixed Arteria Leaf in the Deathbird field before triggering the encounter.
Trigger and defeat the Weeping Peninsula Deathbird.
steps.warning: Holy damage is especially effective against Deathbirds.

steps.instruction: Confirm receipt of the Sacrificial Axe.
Rest and return the world to morning after both night encounters are complete.
Certify the two night bosses and all three unique rewards.
Run the grace audit for every Weeping Peninsula Site of Grace assigned to Objectives 1 and 2.
Run the dungeon and landmark audit: caves, catacombs, tunnel, ruins, churches, towers, Evergaol, Minor Erdtree, and Mausoleum.
Run the boss audit and verify every non-castle encounter is defeated or explicitly documented under approved defer logic.

Run the permanent-collection audit for Sacred Tears, Golden Seed, Crystal Tears, weapons, shields, talismans, cookbooks, Spirit Ashes, spells, and all four reward scarabs: Mighty Shot, Lightning Strike, Divine Fortification, and Poison Mist.
Verify every fixed and non-respawning Objective 1–2 resource record is linked and collected, including exact tunnel, catacomb, cave, coast, graveyard, and Castle Morne approach placements.

Verify all 25 Objective 2 farm sources are registered without requiring immediate random-drop farming: Demi-Humans, Ailing enemies, Tunnel Miners, Erdtree Guardians, Mausoleum forces, and Witchbane Marionettes.
Run the merchant and finite-stock audit for both peninsula merchants.
Verify Irina remains alive with her letter accepted, Edgar has not been contacted, and Sellen's imprisoned body was not harmed.
steps.warning: These states protect Castle Morne and Sellen progression.

steps.instruction: Verify the Walking Mausoleum remains unused unless the Remembrance duplication plan explicitly authorized a selection.
Mark Objective 2 complete and finish at Castle Morne Lift, ready to begin Castle Morne.
steps.warning: Do not enter the castle until Objective 3 begins.

steps.instruction: Rest at Castle Morne Lift, spend any vulnerable runes, confirm Irina's Letter is in inventory, and prepare a ranged pulling option.
steps.warning: Objective 2 must be complete; Edgar should remain uncontacted.

steps.instruction: Ride the entrance lift to the upper landing and activate the Castle Morne summoning pool before entering the courtyard.
steps.warning: The summoning pool is at the top of the lift near the courtyard entrance.

steps.instruction: Take the left branch, clear the two dogs, and collect the placed Smithing Stone [2].
steps.warning: Pull the dogs away from the central Misbegotten group.

steps.instruction: Return to the main courtyard, eliminate the remaining dogs first, then pull the praying Misbegotten from the corpse mound in small groups.
steps.warning: Avoid engaging the full courtyard mob at once.

steps.instruction: Climb the burning corpse mound and collect Fire Grease ×2 from the upper ledge.
Take the forward courtyard path and defeat the Lesser Mad Pumpkin Head guarding the southern pickup area.
steps.warning: Use a backstab or charged opening before it fully turns to face you.

steps.instruction: Collect Smithing Stone [1] ×3 from the corpse beyond the Mad Pumpkin Head.
Return behind the burning corpse mound, enter the armory, and open the chest near the entrance to obtain the Claymore.
steps.warning: Turn left immediately after entering the armory; the chest is partly screened by barricades.

steps.instruction: Clear the connected armory rooms and follow the interior route until you reach the ladder leading to the upper ramparts.
steps.warning: Stop at the ladder base; Objective 3.B begins with the climb.

steps.instruction: Verify the summoning pool, Smithing Stone [2], Fire Grease ×2, Smithing Stone [1] ×3, Claymore, courtyard clear, and armory route before closing 3.A.
steps.warning: Do not climb into the upper ramparts until Objective 3.B begins.

steps.instruction: Climb the armory ladder to the upper ramparts and pause while the Godrick soldiers and Misbegotten engage one another.
steps.warning: Do not rush into the center; use the ongoing battle to separate targets.

steps.instruction: Clear the upper battle platform, prioritizing any surviving ranged or winged Misbegotten before looting.
steps.warning: Watch the platform edges while fighting airborne enemies.

steps.instruction: Collect the Steel-Wire Torch from the outer rampart ledge beside the battle platform.
Collect the Furlcalling Finger Remedy from the central upper-rampart platform.
Climb the ladder on the western side of the platform to the higher parapet.
steps.warning: The route continues through the broken section of wall above.

steps.instruction: Locate the broken wall and drop onto the canvas awning below, then follow the narrow rampart forward.
steps.prerequisites: Steel-Wire Torch and Furlcalling Finger Remedy collected
steps.warning: This is a committed drop; confirm the upper battle platform is complete first.

steps.instruction: Drop to the upper bridge and collect the Golden Rune [4] before continuing along the rampart.
Approach carefully, bait the two ranged Winged Misbegotten down one at a time, then defeat the praying Misbegotten on the walkway.
steps.warning: Retreat behind the wall after drawing aggro so the ranged enemies come to you.

steps.instruction: Collect the Golden Rune [2] from the corpse hanging over the upper passage.
At the upper-rampart end, collect both fixed Smithing Stone [2] pickups before taking Edgar's branch.
At the route fork, take the ladder down toward Edgar's eastern tower; do not take the one-way descent toward Behind the Castle.
steps.warning: The Behind the Castle descent belongs to Objective 3.C.

steps.instruction: Clear the soldiers and Misbegotten on the lower rampart, then follow the wooden stairs to the top of Edgar's tower.
steps.warning: Avoid striking Edgar when finishing enemies near the tower.
steps.location: Castle Morne eastern rampart / Edgar tower

steps.instruction: Register Castle Morne's Winged and Scaly Misbegotten as sources for Misbegotten Shortbow, Iron Cleaver, and Longhaft Axe; continue without remaining to farm.
Speak with Castellan Edgar and exhaust his initial dialogue to receive a Sacrificial Twig.
steps.warning: Do not attack Edgar; his quest state and later invasion must remain intact.

steps.instruction: Choose Give Irina's Letter and deliver the letter to Edgar.
steps.warning: Complete this handoff before defeating Leonine Misbegotten.

steps.instruction: Continue speaking with Edgar until all post-letter dialogue is exhausted and he explains that he must recover Castle Morne's treasured sword before leaving.
steps.warning: This state enables Edgar's summon sign for the Leonine Misbegotten battle.

steps.instruction: Descend from Edgar's tower, return to the upper route fork, and stop before the one-way drop toward Behind the Castle.
steps.warning: Do not descend to the grace until Objective 3.C begins.

steps.instruction: Verify Steel-Wire Torch, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Golden Rune [4], Golden Rune [2], Smithing Stone [2] ×2, Sacrificial Twig, all three Misbegotten farm sources, Edgar's complete pre-boss dialogue, Irina's Letter delivery, and summon availability before closing 3.B.
steps.warning: End at the upper fork with Edgar alive and Leonine Misbegotten undefeated.

steps.instruction: From the upper route fork, take the one-way descent toward the rear of the castle and follow the broken rampart to the grace ledge.
steps.warning: Committed drop; Edgar's pre-boss dialogue must already be exhausted.
steps.location: Castle Morne upper fork / rear descent

steps.instruction: Activate the Behind the Castle Site of Grace.
Rest if needed, refill flasks, and survey the cliffside route before leaving the grace.
steps.warning: The remaining path is largely one-way until Beside the Rampart Gaol.

steps.instruction: Descend the cliff ledges carefully and land on the first rooftop and wooden walkway along the rear wall.
steps.warning: Use controlled drops and do not bypass the lower item platform.

steps.instruction: Walk off the near edge onto the lower wooden platform and collect the Stonesword Key.
steps.warning: Collect before crossing to the next structure.

steps.instruction: Enter the nearby prison room and eliminate the Misbegotten and the Skeletal Slime waiting above the pickup.
steps.warning: Dislodge the ceiling slime with a ranged attack.

steps.instruction: Collect the Pickled Turtle Neck from the prison room.
Continue northwest along the exterior rampart, clear the remaining Misbegotten, and defeat the Scaly Misbegotten guarding the western tower.
steps.warning: Fight away from the ledges.

steps.instruction: Climb the western-tower ladder, circle the rooftop, and open the chest to obtain the Twinblade Talisman.
Descend the ladder and move onto the nearby roof route leading toward the prison-tower opening; stop before the committed beam descent.
steps.warning: Do not drop through the roof until Objective 3.D begins.

steps.instruction: Verify Behind the Castle grace, Stonesword Key, Pickled Turtle Neck, western-rampart clear, Scaly Misbegotten defeat, and Twinblade Talisman before closing 3.C.
steps.warning: End above the prison-tower descent; Objective 3.D handles the Whip, gaol grace, shoreline, and boss approach.

steps.instruction: From the staged prison-tower roof, drop to the lower rear yard and collect the three Tarnished Golden Sunflowers beside the tree.
steps.warning: Use the lower roof and ground-level landing rather than attempting a long direct fall.

steps.instruction: Move southeast around the structure, cross the short gap, and align carefully over the square roof opening above the prison tower.
steps.warning: The beam descent is committed.

steps.instruction: Drop onto the first narrow beam and collect the Smithing Stone [2].
steps.warning: Falling past the beam requires a grace reset to recover the pickup.

steps.instruction: Descend from the first beam to the lower beam and then to the prison-cell floor.
steps.warning: Prepare to sprint through the doorway.

steps.instruction: Run outside, draw the rats and Misbegotten into the open yard, and clear the prison-cell ambush safely.
steps.warning: Do not remain boxed inside the cell.

steps.instruction: Return to the cleared prison cell and collect the Whip from the corpse.
Exit the cell, turn left around the exterior corner, and activate the Beside the Rampart Gaol Site of Grace.
Cross the narrow wooden bridge and defeat the axe-wielding and ranged Winged Misbegotten guarding the lower approach.
steps.warning: Advance slowly to control the two-enemy engagement.

steps.instruction: Loot the corpse beside the barrels and crates for Throwing Dagger ×8.
Enter the narrow water passage and collect Fire Arrow ×15 from the corpse.
Climb down the nearby ladder to the shoreline and move through the Spirit Jellyfish area without attacking the passive jellyfish.
steps.warning: Preserve flasks and avoid provoking the jellyfish.

steps.instruction: Defeat the Giant Crab that emerges near the shoreline approach.
steps.warning: Fight on open ground away from the jellyfish cluster.

steps.instruction: Circle behind the tower at the base of the ladder and collect the Somber Smithing Stone [1].
steps.warning: Collect before approaching the fog gate.

steps.instruction: Approach the Leonine Misbegotten fog gate and confirm Edgar's gold summon sign is available, but do not enter or summon yet.
steps.warning: Objective 3.E begins with boss readiness and summon choice.

steps.instruction: Verify Tarnished Golden Sunflower ×3, Smithing Stone [2], Whip, Beside the Rampart Gaol grace, Throwing Dagger ×8, Fire Arrow ×15, Somber Smithing Stone [1], shoreline clear, and Edgar's summon sign before closing 3.D.
steps.warning: End outside the fog gate with Leonine Misbegotten undefeated.

steps.instruction: Rest at Beside the Rampart Gaol, spend vulnerable runes, refill flasks, confirm the active weapon and consumable loadout, and equip the intended boss support option.
steps.warning: Do not enter the arena until readiness checks are complete.

steps.instruction: Return to the fog gate and choose the encounter support plan: summon Edgar from his gold sign if desired, and prepare an available Spirit Ash if it is part of the intended challenge level.
steps.warning: Edgar's summon is optional.

steps.instruction: Enter the Morne Moangrave arena, establish space on the open sand, and engage Leonine Misbegotten.
steps.warning: Avoid being driven into the arena edge.

steps.instruction: Dodge through the ends of Leonine's aggressive combinations, punish the brief recovery windows, and use charged or jumping attacks when it is safe to build stance damage.
steps.warning: Do not trade through extended combos.

steps.instruction: Defeat Leonine Misbegotten and confirm the boss and achievement completion state.
steps.warning: Victory awards 3,800 runes.

steps.instruction: Confirm receipt of the Grafted Blade Greatsword and register it as a Legendary Armament.
Activate the Morne Moangrave Site of Grace that appears in the defeated boss arena.
steps.warning: Activate before leaving.

steps.instruction: Confirm that Edgar's castle duty is fulfilled and that his post-boss dialogue is now available at his tower.
steps.warning: Do not visit Irina before returning to Edgar.

steps.instruction: Verify Leonine Misbegotten defeated, 3,800 runes awarded, achievement state registered, Grafted Blade Greatsword obtained, Morne Moangrave grace active, and Edgar's post-boss return staged before closing 3.E.
steps.warning: End at Morne Moangrave; Objective 3.F begins with the return to Edgar.

steps.instruction: Fast travel from Morne Moangrave to Castle Morne Lift and prepare for a short return through the respawned entry route.
steps.warning: Return to Edgar before revisiting Irina.

steps.instruction: Ride the lift, pass through the courtyard and armory, climb to the upper ramparts, and retrace the Edgar branch to his tower.
steps.warning: Enemies have respawned; secure the route before climbing.

steps.instruction: Speak with Edgar and exhaust all post-boss dialogue; confirm that he thanks you for recovering the treasured sword and resolves to return to Irina.
steps.warning: Continue until dialogue repeats.

steps.instruction: Fast travel away after exhausting Edgar's dialogue and confirm that his castle duty is closed and he has departed the tower.
steps.warning: Refresh the area by fast travel.

steps.instruction: Fast travel to the Bridge of Sacrifice Site of Grace and ride a short distance south to Irina's roadside location.
steps.warning: Do not continue to Liurnia or Revenger's Shack.

steps.instruction: Discover Irina's body beside the road and register her Weeping Peninsula quest state as deceased.
steps.warning: Irina cannot be saved in the normal completed sequence.

steps.instruction: Speak with Edgar beside Irina, exhaust all mourning dialogue, and hear his vow to hunt those responsible.
steps.warning: Continue until dialogue repeats.

steps.instruction: Record Edgar the Revenger at Revenger's Shack as an active Liurnia continuation and defer the invasion until that regional route reaches the shack.
steps.warning: Do not resolve Revenger's Shack during Weeping Peninsula.

steps.instruction: Verify Edgar's post-boss tower dialogue, castle departure, Irina's death state, Edgar's complete mourning dialogue, and the preserved Revenger's Shack continuation before closing 3.F.
steps.warning: End at Irina's roadside location; Objective 3.G performs the full Castle Morne audit.

steps.instruction: Verify all four Castle Morne Sites of Grace are active: Castle Morne Lift, Behind the Castle, Beside the Rampart Gaol, and Morne Moangrave.
steps.warning: Castle Morne Lift was activated during Objective 2.L.

steps.instruction: Verify the entrance summoning pool, armory ladder, upper-rampart route, Edgar branch, one-way rear descent, western tower, prison-beam descent, and shoreline approach were all completed.
steps.warning: Respawning enemies do not invalidate traversal completion.

steps.instruction: Verify the five permanent Castle Morne rewards are registered and the three Misbegotten farm sources are documented: Claymore, Steel-Wire Torch, Twinblade Talisman, Whip, Grafted Blade Greatsword, Misbegotten Shortbow, Iron Cleaver, and Longhaft Axe.
steps.warning: Register the Grafted Blade Greatsword in Legendary Armaments.

steps.instruction: Verify all 15 Castle Morne finite-resource records are acquired, including the upper-bridge Golden Rune [4], upper-rampart Smithing Stone [2] ×2, courtyard stones, Sacrificial Twig, Stonesword Key, ammunition, and Somber Smithing Stone [1].
steps.warning: Respawning crafting materials do not block this fixed-pickup audit.

steps.instruction: Verify the Lesser Mad Pumpkin Head, western Scaly Misbegotten, shoreline Giant Crab, and Leonine Misbegotten encounter records are complete.
steps.warning: Ordinary respawning enemies and farmable drops do not block completion.

steps.instruction: Verify Edgar's initial audience, letter delivery, post-boss tower dialogue, departure, roadside mourning state, and Irina's waiting and death states are all registered.
steps.warning: All four Edgar dialogue windows must be exhausted.

steps.instruction: Verify Leonine Misbegotten is permanently defeated, the 3,800-rune victory was recorded, the Leonine Misbegotten achievement is complete, and the Grafted Blade Greatsword counts toward Legendary Armaments.
steps.warning: Legendary Armaments remains an incomplete game-wide collection.

steps.instruction: Verify Edgar the Revenger remains deferred to Revenger's Shack in Liurnia and that Irina's completed state preserves Lightseeker Hyetta's later appearance.
steps.warning: Do not resolve Revenger's Shack during Act I.

steps.instruction: Confirm Objectives 1–3 of the Weeping Peninsula are fully production-structured and that no castle, dungeon, merchant, boss, NPC, or fixed collectible remains unresolved within the region.
steps.warning: Approved future continuations do not block certification.

steps.instruction: Fast travel to Gatefront, spend any accumulated runes, and stop before riding through Stormgate so Global Objective 11 can begin from a clean staging point.
steps.warning: Do not begin Stormhill until Objective 10.G is closed.

steps.instruction: Mark Global 10.G / Local 3.G complete, certify Global 10 / Local 3, and close the Weeping Peninsula Completion Unit before loading Stormhill.
steps.warning: Castle Morne and the Weeping Peninsula are now production-complete.

steps.instruction: Begin at Gatefront, spend any vulnerable runes, refill flasks, confirm Torrent is available, and set out during daylight toward Stormgate.
steps.warning: Do not begin Stormhill from an unresolved Weeping Peninsula state.

steps.instruction: Ride north through Stormgate, control or bypass the Godrick soldiers and descending Troll, and collect the Golden Rune [1] from the fixed corpse inside the gate.
steps.warning: The enemies respawn; the fixed rune is the completion requirement.

steps.instruction: Continue up the main road beyond Stormgate and collect the Golden Seed from the spectral sapling on the right side of the road.
steps.warning: Separate from Roderika's later Golden Seed.

steps.instruction: Follow the road northwest and activate the Stormhill Shack Site of Grace.
Rest at Stormhill Shack and use the collected Golden Seed if the Add Charge to Flask option is currently available.
steps.warning: Retain the seed if additional seeds are required.

steps.instruction: Move to the small wooden platform just south of the shack and loot the corpse to obtain the Stonesword Key.
Enter the shack, speak with Roderika, and continue through her account of her grafted companions until the Sitting Sideways gesture is received.
steps.warning: Complete before defeating Godrick or touching a Liurnia Site of Grace.

steps.instruction: Continue speaking with Roderika until she entrusts the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes to you.
steps.warning: Preserve the summon for its later Stargazers' Ruins use.

steps.instruction: Exhaust Roderika's remaining dialogue, including her message for the chrysalids in Stormveil Castle, until her lines repeat.
Record the Chrysalids' Memento return window: when the memento is collected in Stormveil, return it to Roderika at the shack before defeating Godrick or resting at a Liurnia Site of Grace.
steps.warning: The memento retrieval and return belong to the Stormveil route.

steps.instruction: Verify Stormgate crossed, Golden Rune [1], roadside Golden Seed, Stormhill Shack grace, Stonesword Key, Sitting Sideways, Spirit Jellyfish Ashes, all current Roderika dialogue, and the preserved memento-return window before closing 1.A.
steps.warning: End at Stormhill Shack; Objective 1.B travels east to Warmaster's Shack.

steps.instruction: From Stormhill Shack, ride east through the wooded hillside to Warmaster's Shack without beginning the wider northern Stormhill sweep.
steps.warning: Highroad Cave and the wider sweep remain later packages.

steps.instruction: Activate the Warmaster's Shack Site of Grace and rest until daytime if Knight Bernahl is not present.
Enter the shack, complete Knight Bernahl's introductory exchange, select the Talk option, and exhaust every currently available line.
steps.warning: Required to spawn the Bell Bearing Hunter.

steps.instruction: Register Bernahl's complete initial inventory of ten Ashes of War and verify the combined purchase cost is 9,700 runes.
steps.warning: Eruption and Assassin's Gambit are later Volcano Manor additions.

steps.instruction: Review No Skill, Storm Blade, and Impaling Thrust as the highest-value early options; purchase any of them only if they support the active build or immediate route.
steps.warning: All unpurchased Ashes remain mandatory for a later merchant-completion closeout.

steps.instruction: Record Stamp (Upward Cut), Kick, Endure, War Cry, Spinning Slash, Quickstep, and Parry as deferred purchases unless any is immediately useful.
steps.warning: Deferred does not mean optional: every remaining finite merchant item must be purchased during a later completion closeout.

steps.instruction: Exhaust Bernahl's available dialogue, leave him alive, and preserve his Volcano Manor, Farum Azula, and legendary-armament progression.
steps.warning: Do not attack or kill Bernahl. His ten-item Stormhill stock remains tracked for eventual full purchase.

steps.instruction: Record the Warmaster's Shack Bell Bearing Hunter as intentionally deferred to Objective 1.D's consolidated Night Operation after the Deathroot pickup.
steps.warning: Do not trigger the Hunter now; the later timing provides smoother difficulty and avoids a separate night cycle.

steps.instruction: Confirm all ten initial Ashes of War are registered with their prices and acquisition source, regardless of which purchases were made immediately.
steps.warning: The combined initial stock remains 9,700 runes for later completion planning.

steps.instruction: Mark any Ashes bought now as acquired and leave every unpurchased entry explicitly open in the merchant-completion ledger.
steps.warning: No finite merchant item may disappear from the 100% closeout simply because its purchase was deferred.

steps.instruction: Retain enough runes for upgrades, levels, and route-critical purchases; do not spend 9,700 runes merely to close Bernahl's shop during this visit.
steps.warning: Completion priority is preserved by the later closeout dependency, not by immediate overspending.

steps.instruction: Confirm Bernahl remains alive and available at Warmaster's Shack and that the Bell Bearing Hunter remains untriggered for the later night package.
steps.warning: The Hunter's future spawn requires Bernahl's Talk dialogue to be exhausted.

steps.instruction: Create the mandatory merchant-closeout dependency for every unpurchased Bernahl Ash of War.
steps.warning: Closeout timing remains flexible, but eventual purchase of all finite stock is mandatory.

steps.instruction: Record that the Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing and its Twin Maiden stock remain unavailable until the Objective 1.D Bell Bearing Hunter operation.
steps.warning: Do not treat the locked bone stock as a missing item during 1.B.

steps.instruction: Remain at Warmaster's Shack and prepare to travel east to Saintsbridge for Highroad Cave.
steps.warning: Roundtable delivery of the Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing occurs after the later night operation.

steps.instruction: Verify Warmaster's Shack grace, Bernahl's dialogue and ten-item inventory registration, optional purchases recorded, all remaining purchases formally deferred, Bernahl preserved, and the Bell Bearing Hunter assigned to Objective 1.D.
steps.warning: End at Warmaster's Shack; Objective 1.C begins with Saintsbridge and Highroad Cave.

steps.instruction: From Warmaster's Shack, ride east toward Saintsbridge without beginning the wider northern Stormhill sweep.
steps.warning: Objective 1.D handles the surrounding overworld content.

steps.instruction: Activate the Saintsbridge Site of Grace to establish the surface checkpoint for the river descent.
Use the Spirit Spring below and just south of Saintsbridge to descend safely, then ride north along the river past the Land Octopuses to the cave opening in the western cliff.
steps.warning: Respawning river enemies and materials do not block completion.

steps.instruction: Enter Highroad Cave, activate its Site of Grace, rest, and equip the Lantern before proceeding into the darkness.
Descend the first vertical shaft using the staggered ledges and clear the wolves in the illuminated chamber at the bottom.
steps.warning: Use controlled drops.

steps.instruction: Take the side passage before the next descent, eliminate the guarding wolves, and collect Golden Rune [1].
Descend the second shaft, ignore the Cave Moss-only dead end, and clear the sleeping wolves near the campsite.
steps.warning: Cave Moss is respawning and excluded from the finite audit.

steps.instruction: Break through the barrels on the left-hand branch, defeat the hidden wolf, and collect Arteria Leaf ×3 from the corpse at the ledge.
Drop into the lower wolf chamber, clear the white wolf and the remaining pack one at a time, and collect Fire Grease ×2.
steps.warning: Avoid drawing the full pack simultaneously.

steps.instruction: Enter the large waterfall chamber, register the Stake of Marika, and clear the bats along the upper-left ledge.
steps.warning: The lower water is lethal.

steps.instruction: Follow the upper ledge to the corpse and collect Smithing Stone [1] ×3 after defeating the two ambushing bats.
Drop into the waterfall, enter the side cave above the lower chamber, defeat the bats, and collect Smithing Stone [2].
Continue deeper into the side cave, clear or avoid the small Land Octopuses, and collect Golden Rune [4] behind the small waterfall.
Take a running jump from the waterfall ledge onto the collapsed stone pillar and follow it to the circular platform in the center of the chamber.
steps.warning: Missing the pillar causes a lethal fall into the water.

steps.instruction: Clear the bats on and around the circular platform, then collect the Shamshir from the central corpse.
Jump northeast to the lit ledge and pass through the chamber with the Giant Land Octopus; defeat it or sprint through to the far tunnel.
steps.warning: Land Octopus Ovary is farmable and nonblocking.

steps.instruction: Follow the tunnel beyond the octopus chamber, collect the Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and drop to the ledge leading toward the boss fog.
At the fog gate, heal, confirm the intended physical or magic damage setup, and prepare to remain close to the Guardian Golem's ankles.
steps.warning: Avoid Fire, Holy, Lightning, and status-focused plans.

steps.instruction: Enter the arena, stay behind either heel, use charged or jumping attacks on the exposed ankles, and avoid the stomps and delayed halberd swings.
When the Guardian Golem topples, move to the glowing chest core for a critical attack, then return to the ankles and repeat.
Defeat the Guardian Golem and confirm the 1,700-rune reward and permanent Highroad Cave clear state.

Confirm receipt of the Blue Dancer Charm, use the return-to-entrance prompt, and verify both graces, Shamshir, all seven finite pickups, Guardian Golem defeat, and Blue Dancer Charm before closing 1.C.
steps.warning: End at the Highroad Cave grace.

steps.instruction: From Highroad Cave, fast travel to Saintsbridge and ride east toward the crater where Iron Fist Alexander is calling for help.
steps.warning: Do not continue into Caelid; this package remains within northern Stormhill and its immediate border routes.

steps.instruction: Speak with Iron Fist Alexander, agree to help him, and exhaust his dialogue before striking the jar.
steps.warning: Attack Alexander only from behind and only after he asks for assistance.

steps.instruction: Use a charged attack from behind to free Alexander, then receive the Triumphant Delight gesture and Exalted Flesh.
steps.warning: Stop attacking immediately once he is freed.

steps.instruction: Exhaust Alexander's post-rescue dialogue and preserve his next quest stage for the Gael Tunnel and Radahn sequence.
steps.warning: Do not attack Alexander again after the rescue.

steps.instruction: Ride west and northwest from Saintsbridge to the cliffside entrance of Deathtouched Catacombs.
steps.warning: The surrounding overworld skeletons are respawning and do not block dungeon completion.

steps.instruction: Enter Deathtouched Catacombs and activate its Site of Grace.
steps.warning: Equip a Strike weapon or Holy damage option if available; skeletons revive unless their remains are struck.

steps.instruction: Clear the first skeleton chamber and collect the first two Grave Glovewort [1] pickups.
steps.warning: After each skeleton falls, strike the glowing remains to prevent revival.

steps.instruction: Advance into the next chamber, collect the third Grave Glovewort [1] and Grave Violet, and secure the route toward the hidden side passage.
Enter the hidden side passage, defeat the skeleton archers, collect the fourth Grave Glovewort [1], and loot the Uchigatana and Arrow ×5.
steps.warning: Confirm the Uchigatana is registered before leaving the side passage.

steps.instruction: Descend to the lower room, collect the fifth Grave Glovewort [1] and Bloodrose ×3, then pull the lever that opens the boss door.
steps.warning: All five Grave Glovewort [1] pickups should now be accounted for.

steps.instruction: Return to the boss door, heal, prepare for a partially injured Black Knife Assassin, and enter the arena.
steps.warning: The assassin is fast and mobile but begins below full health.

steps.instruction: Stay close enough to punish the Black Knife Assassin's finished combinations, guard or dodge the rapid knife strings, and use stance pressure when safe.
steps.warning: Avoid panic rolling away from the delayed follow-up attacks.

steps.instruction: Defeat the Black Knife Assassin and confirm receipt of the Assassin's Crimson Dagger.
Open the boss-room chest to obtain the Deathroot, verify every fixed catacomb pickup, and register Deathtouched Catacombs as cleared.
steps.warning: The Deathroot remains available for Gurranq's later reward progression.

steps.instruction: Exit the catacombs and ride northeast toward the giant skeleton remains near the northeastern Stormhill cliffs.
steps.warning: Remain on the upper plateau rather than descending into the river.

steps.instruction: Search the giant skeleton's ribs and collect the Lance Talisman.
Approach the nearby Godrick soldier camp, eliminate the outer guards, and secure the lower tents and barricades.
steps.warning: A mounted Godrick Knight patrols the camp and is handled after the fixed pickups.

steps.instruction: Loot the camp corpses and chest to obtain the Beast Crest Heater Shield and Exalted Flesh.
Climb onto the ruined structure above the camp and collect the Lance.
steps.warning: Use the broken walls or Torrent to reach the roof safely.

steps.instruction: Defeat the mounted Godrick Knight patrolling northeast of Warmaster's Shack and confirm Ash of War: Golden Vow.
steps.warning: Fight on open ground so the horse charge has room to pass.

steps.instruction: Destroy the visible scarab west of Deathtouched Catacombs and collect Somber Smithing Stone [1].
